title: Scoobert Doobert Shares Chill Vibes With "Dancing in the Moonlight (Beach)"
htmlContent:
Scoobert Doobert's recent release, "Dancing in the Moonlight (Beach)," is a must-listen for those searching for chill vibes. The song covers King Harvest's classic hit and has already found its way onto Spotify's Official Editorial Chill Vibes Playlist. Scoobert Doobert's version of the song perfectly captures the feel-good nature of the original while infusing it with his unique style.

As a multi-talented producer, engineer, and songwriter, Scoobert Doobert has a firm grasp of multiple languages, including Japanese. This has led to exciting collaborations with artists worldwide, including the J-Pop band CHAI. Scoobert Doobert has produced several tracks for CHAI, including the theme song for the TV mini-series "Two People Who Can't Fall in Love" and the single "Dream Story," which will be featured in movie theaters across Japan.

With a string of vibey bops and exciting collabs and remixes on the horizon, Scoobert Doobert's future looks bright. Check out his entire catalog on Spotify, and stay tuned for more from this talented artist.
